notFound.title: Page not found

starter.title: Build your next app with Eazo
starter.subtitle: You now have a clean foundation with auth, data access, and platform integrations ready for your product.

readDocs.title: Read the docs
readDocs.desc: Open AGENTS.md and README.md to understand the template architecture.

replacePage.title: Replace this page
replacePage.desc: Move your product UI into src/components and keep page.tsx thin.

firstFeature.title: Build your first feature
firstFeature.desc: Add API routes under src/app/api and call them from typed helpers.

translations.title: Add translations
translations.desc: Edit en-US / zh-CN strings in src/i18n/locales. LanguageSwitcher and I18nProvider in layout.tsx are already wired.

nextCommand.title: Next command
nextCommand.desc: Start developing and iterate in real time.

req.title: Structured Requirements
req.empty: Paste the show brief, or click "Load demo case" to start.
req.placeholder: e.g. 3-min tech brand opening show, theme "From Individual to Symbiosis", 12 dancers, main LED, two side entries, emotion from restraint to burst…

plan.title: Show Proposal Table
plan.empty: Pick a creative direction and the time-based proposal table will appear here.
plan.note: Click any cell to edit; the formation column is a schematic.

fb.title: Director Feedback
fb.placeholder: e.g. Change to 8 dancers; make the last 30s more powerful; no handheld props.

prop.title: Impact Analysis · Change Preview
prop.hint: Check the changes to apply; unchecked items stay unchanged.
